steps.content: Pulses suddenly keep coming from deep within the art museum.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This painting... the strong power... Why...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Like... it's reading my soul...
They're dead, they're dead, they're dead, they're dead...
Hecate covers her forehead in pain.
Give up... Give up... You can't...

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: It's a painting of fear. It will awaken the fear in people's hearts.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: This painting calls for the fear of losing where one belongs. Everyone... sees different things.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: Like... she does.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Battle mode... Battle mode... Battle mode...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Labyrinth! What's the matter with you?!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...! Did the painting...
The shadows are all defeated, but the museum doesn't return to normal as expected.
Instead, it becomes more violent.
A tiny sound crawls into Labyrinth's mind.
Only a tiny one.
You're here.
I thought that you had forgotten about me long ago.
Haha... You can actually remember that name?

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Mary... Mary?

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Who... are you? And who... am I?
Scenes start flashing in Labyrinth's mind.
There was a pleasant aroma in the restaurant in the afternoon.
Gang, chaos, fights, fear, mobs.
Didn't have the time to act... or apologize.
Because of her, yes, it was all because of her.

steps.speaker: Mary
steps.content: You're... a liar who has forgotten everything, a liar who can't keep her word, Labyrinth.

steps.speaker: Mary
steps.content: It's been a long time, so I'll give you one more chance... if you destroy all the enemies here.

steps.speaker: Mary
steps.content: This is an order from your master... Mary.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: There's no Mary here... Wake up!
Bearing with her headache, Hecate tries to approach Labyrinth.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Preparing to activate, preparing to activate.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Battle mode activated.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Not enough... Not enough at all...

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Not enough to destroy them, not at all.
Labyrinth's body crackles as her Sinner energy surges uncontrollably.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Preparing to switch to overload mode, preparing to switch to overload mode.

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Woah, so sick! This is what a Sinner should look like! She's glowing red all over!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Get out of the way!
The Nightmare pushes Sasha away and takes several solid hits from Labyrinth.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Eliminate... Eliminate... Eliminate all Mary's enemies.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: I won't let you people hurt Mary anymore!

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: It's my responsibility... to protect Mary!

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Overload mode activated!
